operators.name: gelu_forward
semantics: Applies the exact PyTorch GELU activation used in the reference: F.gelu(x), which defaults to the 'none' approximation (0.5 * x * (1 + erf(x / sqrt(2))).
Operates elementwise on the input tensor of float32 on CUDA.
Returns a tensor of the same shape, dtype, device, and layout as input.

operators.name: linear_forward
semantics: Performs a linear transformation: output = input @ weight.T + bias.
Input is reshaped conceptually to [batch_size * seq_len, in_features], but retains its original shape; output is reshaped back to [batch_size, seq_len, out_features].
Uses float32 matrix multiplication on CUDA (likely via cuBLAS).
If bias is not None, it is broadcasted and added to every row of the matrix product.
The operation follows nn.Linear semantics with the given weight and bias tensors.
Returns a new tensor of shape [batch_size, seq_len, out_features] on the same device.
Elementwise GELU activation (default approximation) applied to input float32 tensor of shape [512, 1000, 128].
Result is a float32 tensor of same shape [512, 1000, 128] on CUDA.
Linear transformation: output = x @ weight.T + bias.
Input shape [512, 1000, 128] is viewed as [512*1000, 128] for GEMM; weight shape [256, 128], bias shape [256].
Result is a float32 tensor of shape [512, 1000, 256] on CUDA.
Returns the final tensor, same as step_002.
